svg.title: Nonlinear amplitude limits and failures
svg.desc: Nonlinear forecast errors and invalid initial conditions are accompanied by a solver-tolerance control: tiny-amplitude VAR16 error is numerically sensitive, so it is not solely a nonlinear effect.
